org.xces.graf.uima.example
Class Example

java.lang.Object
  org.xces.graf.uima.example.Example

public class Example
extends Object

This class is an example of how one can use the CASFactory class to convert a Graph to a CAS: updated to work with xmlns="http://www.xces.org/ns/GrAF/1.0/

Version:
1.1
Author:
Madhav Krishna
